structuredContent.text:
## Decisions

- The Q4 2026 roadmap has two items: selective CI builds and the search index rewrite. Everything else waits.
- Lena owns the selective CI builds; target is CI under 4 minutes for a web-only change by 2026-10-15.

## Status

- Selective CI: dependency graph done; job skipping in review. Web-only change builds in 6 minutes today, target is 4.
- Search index rewrite: proposal accepted on 2026-08-25; implementation starts after the SEPA follow-ups close.

The 2026-09-01 sync (`meetings/2026-09-01-platform-sync.md:3-6`, "Status") says a web-only change built in 6 minutes at that point. I didn't check whether the target was met by the deadline.
